summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Monthly Return for Equity Issuer and Hong Kong Depositary Receipts under Chapter 19B of the Exchange Listing Rules. This is a routine regulatory filing reporting share capital movements for May 2026, with no changes in authorized or issued shares. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is disclosed. The filing is purely administrative and does not constitute a special situation.
